method: spawn /usr/lib/chromium/chromium --headless --remote-debugging-port=0 with a fresh mkdtemp --user-data-dir and HOME=<mkdtemp> (isolates chromium-flags.conf); read DevToolsActivePort for the bound loopback port; record /proc/<pid>/cmdline verbatim as observedCmdline; HTTP GET /json/version then /json/protocol; sha256 over exact response bytes; extract the WebMCP domain object verbatim; SIGKILL + profile/HOME rm -rf in a finally block
launcherNote: /usr/bin/chromium is the Arch ELF launcher (14,424 B, file -L: ELF 64-bit LSB pie executable); it merges ~/.config/chromium-flags.conf into argv (observed contents: --ozone-platform=wayland, --ozone-platform-hint=wayland, --enable-features=TouchpadOverscrollHistoryNavigation, --load-extension=~/... literal tilde, --disable-features=Vulkan). This evidence bypasses the launcher entirely by spawning /usr/lib/chromium/chromium directly. observedCmdline shows the effective argv also carries headless-mode additions not in typed argv (--noerrdialogs, --ozone-platform=headless, --ozone-override-screen-size=800,600, --use-angle=swiftshader-webgl) — applied by chromium itself, visible in /proc cmdline.
